packs.name: Concrete Psalms
packs.description: Dark minor-ninth loops at 140-144 with phrygian half-step moves and roots that leave room for a sliding 808.

packs.name: Borough Choir
packs.description: Harmonic-minor progressions voiced like a sampled choir or string section, built for 140-150 bounce drums.

packs.name: South Side Requiem
packs.description: Ominous minor loops for half-time 60-70 or straight 130-145 drill, slow-moving and heavy on the low end.

packs.name: Iron Overture
packs.description: Epic orchestral-trap harmony: suspensions, chromatic mediants and Neapolitan chords for intros and big hooks.

packs.name: Midnight Tribunal
packs.description: Where drill meets film score: tense minor-major sevenths, tritone pulls and string-section voicings.

progressions.title: Kerbside Phrygian
progressions.description: C#m9 rises a half step to Dmaj9#11 and back, with G# kept on top, then a G#7b9 turns it around. The two-root move suits an 808 slide.

progressions.title: Grey Estate Hymn
progressions.description: Fm11 leans on its phrygian neighbor Gbmaj9, then walks down Dbmaj9 and Bbm9 into a long C7b9. Pulse it under sparse hats.

progressions.title: Tower Block Fog
progressions.description: The maj7 in Gm(maj9) slips down to F, Ebmaj7#11 floats, and a quick Abmaj9 to D7b9 snaps it back. Leave it as a pad and let the 808 talk.

progressions.title: Slide Theory
progressions.description: A phrygian Dm9 to Ebmaj9 rock, then a longer walk through Gm9 and A7b9 that lands on a Dm(maj9). Arp it for a glassy pluck line.

progressions.title: Underpass Psalm
progressions.description: Am11 and its half-step Bbmaj7#11 neighbor, then Fmaj9 into a gritty E7#9. The top line answers each stab.

progressions.title: Cold Ends Hymn
progressions.description: Bbm9 climbs a half step to Bmaj7#11, settles on Gbmaj9 and resolves through F7b9. Pulse it on a bell patch.

progressions.title: Night Bus Sermon
progressions.description: A stepwise bass line from E down to D#, then the phrygian Fmaj9#11 for the second phrase. Eight bars that loop under a whole verse.

progressions.title: Ghost Roller
progressions.description: F#m11 nudges up to Gmaj7#11 and back, then Dmaj9 and a C#7 that suspends before it bites. Each chord lands an eighth early.

progressions.title: Lowkey Verdict
progressions.description: Bm9 and the phrygian Cmaj9, closed off with F#7b9. A short piano hook sits on top.

progressions.title: Bando Hymnal
progressions.description: Two long bars each of Ebm9 and the half-step-up Emaj9#11, then a walk down through Cb and Abm9 to Bb7b9. Choir patch, lots of space.

progressions.title: Bridge Lights Off
progressions.description: G#m9 to its phrygian Amaj7#11, then Emaj9 and a D#7b9 that leans on the E. Arpeggiate it for a melodic drill pluck.

progressions.title: Debt Ledger Strings
progressions.description: Cm9 against Dbmaj9#11, an Abmaj7 over the C pedal, then Fm9, Dbmaj9 and a G7b9 to Bdim7 to set up the loop. Pulse it on strings.

progressions.title: Sampled Cathedral
progressions.description: A choir-style line over a falling bass: Am9, E7/G#, Fmaj9, then the Bm7b5 to E7b9 turnaround with the G# kept in. Sing the top line on an aah patch.

progressions.title: Brownstone Psalm
progressions.description: The harmonic-minor B in Cm(maj9) sets the tone, Abmaj7#11 opens it up and Fm9 to G7b9 pulls it back. Stab it on staccato strings.

progressions.title: Violin Smoke
progressions.description: Bass falls G, F, Eb, D under a tight string voicing, then Cm9, the Neapolitan Abmaj9 and F#dim7 lead to a suspended D. Arp it like pizzicato.

progressions.title: Siren Gospel
progressions.description: F#m(maj9) keeps the E# hanging, Dmaj7#11 and Bm9 soften it, and C#7b9 brings the tension back. The top line climbs through the E#.

progressions.title: Uptown Requiem
progressions.description: Inner voices move over a D pedal, then the bass steps down to C# for A7b9. The second time it swaps in the Neapolitan Ebmaj7#11.

progressions.title: Hallway Strings
progressions.description: A line falls D#, D inside the E minor chord, then Cmaj7#11, Am9 and a ii-V in E minor. Ends on a crunchy B7#9 to loop back.

progressions.title: Bodega Choir
progressions.description: Bbm9, Gbmaj7#11 and Ebm9, then F7b9 slides into Edim7 for a chromatic pull back home. Stab it on a vocal chop.

progressions.title: Tunnel Vision Choir
progressions.description: Bm(maj9) and Gmaj7#11 share three notes, Em9 darkens it and F#7b9 closes. The top line is the vocal hook.

progressions.title: Precinct Lament
progressions.description: Eight bars of G# minor: a plain i-VI-iv-V, then a harmonic-minor answer with the half-step Amaj7#11 and a D#7#9 at the end.

progressions.title: Opera Block
progressions.description: Fm(maj9) holds an E natural, Dbmaj7#11 and Bbm9 move by step, and C7b9 brings the E back. Pulse it like an opera chop.

progressions.title: Marble Steps
progressions.description: Long chords with short pickups: Ebm11 leans on a Bb7b9 over D, then Cbmaj7#11 and a dorian Ab13. It ends on a ii-V in Eb minor.

progressions.title: Steel Hymn Uptown
progressions.description: C#m9 to Amaj7#11 with the D# kept on top, then F#m9 and G#7b9. The top line drops from G# to B#.

progressions.title: Hollow Porch
progressions.description: Am(maj9) to Fmaj7#11 with the B held over, then Dm9 and E7b9. Half-time, low and slow.

progressions.title: Block Static
progressions.description: Dm11 jabs at a half-step Ebmaj9, Bbmaj7#11 opens up, and A7#9 grinds against the minor third. Bell stabs over a heavy 808.

progressions.title: Third Floor Wake
progressions.description: Rolled pads at half time: Em9, Cmaj7#11, Am11, B7b9, then a darker second half with the phrygian Fmaj7#11 and a B7#9.

progressions.title: Frostbite Gospel
progressions.description: Gm9, Ebmaj7#11 and Cm9 sit in one hand position, and D7b9 brings the F# in at the end. Organ patch with a short top melody.

progressions.title: Eviction Notice
progressions.description: C#m11 to the phrygian Dmaj7#11, down to Bm9 and G#7b9. A tight cluster that pulses well in eighths.

progressions.title: Lake Effect
progressions.description: Slow half-time arps: Fm9, Dbmaj9, Bbm11, the Neapolitan Gbmaj7#11, then Eb7sus4 and Dbmaj7 over F into C7b9.

progressions.title: Cold Tile
progressions.description: Low, close piano voicings: Bbm(maj9), Gbmaj9, Ebm9 and F7b9, all within a fifth. Keep the stabs short so the 808 cuts through.

progressions.title: Moonless Cul-de-sac
progressions.description: Two-bar chords at half time: Bm9, Gmaj7#11, then Em9 and the Neapolitan Cmaj7#11 into a long F#7b9. The string line falls F# to A#.

progressions.title: Tension Wire
progressions.description: Quick two-beat moves between G#m9 and Amaj7#11, then longer C#m9 and D#7b9. Pushed early on a dark synth.

progressions.title: Stone Chapel
progressions.description: Ebm(maj9), Cm7b5 and Cbmaj7#11 over a bass that falls by thirds, then Bb7b9. Organ or a slow choir.

progressions.title: Wake at Midnight
progressions.description: Cm11 and the half-step Dbmaj9, an Ab7#11 pulling hard toward G, then Fm9, Dm7b5 and Abmaj9 into G7b9.

progressions.title: Funeral Drive
progressions.description: F#m9 to the phrygian Gmaj7#11, Bm11, then a C#7#9 with both thirds. Rolled piano with a short top line.

progressions.title: Throne of Ash
progressions.description: i-bVI-bIII-bVII with every chord suspended first, then a second half through Bbmaj9#11, the Neapolitan Ebmaj9 and a suspended A7. The brass line rides on top.

progressions.title: Siege Engine
progressions.description: The upper voices barely move while the bass goes C, Ab, Bb, D. Pulse it on marcato strings under the drums.

progressions.title: Coronation in Rust
progressions.description: The first half stays in E minor. The second turns to Cm9, Abmaj7#11 and the Neapolitan Fmaj7#11, chromatic mediants that make it sound like a film score, then B7b9.

progressions.title: Kingdom Falls
progressions.description: i-bVI-bIII-bVII in F minor with the VII suspended before it resolves over G. Choir pad, top line on a solo voice.

progressions.title: Ninth Legion
progressions.description: Am9, Fmaj7#11 and Cmaj7 over G, then a Gsus4 that drops to E7b9. Brass stabs for a big trap intro.

progressions.title: Black Banner
progressions.description: Gmadd9, Ebmaj9, Bbmaj7 over D and a suspended F, then Gm9 into the Neapolitan Abmaj9 and a D7 that suspends before the b9.

progressions.title: Last Cavalry
progressions.description: Bmadd9 and Gmaj7#11 use the same upper notes, Dmaj9 sits over A, and a suspended A climbs to C# to restart. Pushed horn hits.

progressions.title: Cathedral Siege
progressions.description: A to F is a chromatic-mediant jump and Dmaj9 is the Neapolitan. The second half climbs through Emaj9 and B7sus4 to G#7b9.

progressions.title: Pyre at Dawn
progressions.description: The same four notes sit over F# and then D, which is what makes the change sound big. Then Amaj9 over E and a suspended C#7. Arp it fast for an orchestral-trap pluck.

progressions.title: Dread Fanfare
progressions.description: Ebm9 against its Neapolitan Fbmaj9#11, down to Cbmaj9 and Bb7b9. Short brass stabs.

progressions.title: Obsidian March
progressions.description: i-bVI-bIII-bVII with a suspension, then the chromatic mediant Cmaj7#11 and the Neapolitan Amaj9 before D#7b9. A slow march in pulsing strings.

progressions.title: Titan Requiem
progressions.description: Bbm(maj9) to Gbmaj7#11, then a chromatic-mediant jump to Dmaj7#11 before F7b9 snaps home. Rolled choir chords.

progressions.title: Velvet Guillotine
progressions.description: Dm(maj9), Bbmaj7#11 and Gm9, then the Neapolitan Ebmaj7 into an A7#9. String stabs that suit a film-score drill beat.

progressions.title: Witness Stand
progressions.description: Emadd9 against the phrygian Fmaj7#11, a D#dim7 under it, then Cmaj9 and B7b9. Choir chops pushed ahead of the beat.

progressions.title: Eclipse Protocol
progressions.description: A line falls E, Eb under the F minor chord, then Db to A, a chromatic mediant that keeps the Ab as G#. Bbm9, Gbmaj9 and a suspended C7 finish it. Arp it on a dark synth.

progressions.title: Graveyard Shift Strings
progressions.description: Gm11 to the half-step Abmaj7#11, which an 808 can slide between, then a D7#9 with both thirds.

progressions.title: Paper Crowns
progressions.description: Two-beat changes: Bm9, Gmaj9, Em9, F#7b9, with C#m7b5 swapped in the second time. A piano hook rides on top.

progressions.title: Wolf Senate
progressions.description: i-bVI-bIII-bVII where the III and VII each suspend before they resolve, then Fmaj7#11, Dm9 and a suspended E7. The brass melody comes down the scale.

progressions.title: Concrete Halo
progressions.description: Cm9 jabs at a half-step Dbmaj9#11, Ab7#11 pulls into G7#9. Bell stabs over a sliding 808.

progressions.title: Last Rites Uptown
progressions.description: The inner voice falls E#, E under the F# minor chord, then Dmaj7#11, Bm9 and a minor ii-V. The Neapolitan Gmaj9 goes to C#7#9 at the end.

progressions.title: Interrogation Room
progressions.description: Half-time Bbm11 climbs a half step to Bmaj7#11, then Gbmaj9 over a Bb pedal and F7b9. Slow rolled pad.

progressions.title: Shadow Cabinet
progressions.description: C#m(maj9) moves to C#m9, Amaj7#11 follows, then G#7b9 and its tritone substitute D7#11 pull back to the top.

progressions.title: Basalt Monolith
progressions.description: Abm9 and Fbmaj7#11 share all four upper notes, then Cbmaj9 and a suspended Gb. The second half adds the Neapolitan Amaj7#11 and a Dbm9 to Eb7b9 cadence.

progressions.title: Ivory Gallows
progressions.description: The line falls D, Db under the Eb minor chord, then Cbmaj7#11 and a quick Neapolitan Fbmaj7 before Bb7b9. Arp it on a felt piano.
